sample.summary:
PRICE REDUCED: MemoSpark is now offered at $1,490 for a faster sale.

MemoSpark is a functional study web application for students who want several active-recall methods in one lightweight interface. It includes flashcards with creation, editing, CSV import/export, study sessions and progress tracking; text recall with word-level comparison, similarity scoring and progress history; and image memorization with labels, masks, quiz mode and scoring. The wider codebase also includes folder and study-file organization, Supabase authentication and persistence architecture, a free/VIP plan structure, and Stripe Checkout, Billing Portal and webhook code. A clean account-free preview using fictional data is live at memospark.app. MemoSpark is sold as a pre-revenue code and domain asset, not as a profitable operating company: lifetime and TTM revenue are $0, no profit was generated, there are zero paying customers, and the one historical free registration is excluded from the sale. The buyer receives the sanitized source package, domain, brand assets, deployment and handover documentation, fictional demo material, and 14 calendar days of setup support capped at five hours. Buyer-owned Vercel, Supabase and Stripe projects should be created or migrated, with database policies and the full payment lifecycle revalidated before commercial relaunch. No verified traffic, retention or conversion metrics are claimed.

Two-minute buyer demo (unlisted YouTube): https://youtu.be/xBJJErWshb4

Realistic growth opportunities include completing a true spaced-repetition queue, launching subject-specific templates, improving onboarding and conversion, adding analytics and annual billing, publishing SEO content, and localizing the product further. These are opportunities, not forecasts.
